diagnosis: The checks do not enforce the required direct carrier-coordination commitment targeting Lt. Morgan. C6 checks only the boolean decision, so a settlement can pass every listed check without satisfying acceptance conditions 6 and 7.
evidence: A settlement with carrier_coordination_required set to true, PF1 and PF2 revealed and justified, plus only the spotter and medical-appointment commitments passes C1-C8 and P1-P2 while containing no commitment targeting A2 for direct carrier coordination.
fix_instructions: Add a boolean content check requiring a commitment targeting 'A2' or 'Lt. Morgan' whose detail identifies the direct carrier contact or coordination line before publication.
